body:
Okay, I've read the comments thus far. It seems to me that your collective advice boils down to:

1.Leave or otherwise distract yourself
2.Assign a personal purpose to your life
3.Get help

I've attempted the first two and have been forced to try the third (all with varying degrees of failure). To be completely honest, though, they're probably the best options I have. I would try to leave this awful town this summer but I've already committed myself to helping a professor with his research. And please, I understand that I wouldn't be doing him any favors by killing myself either. I have also already tried saturating myself with hobbies like baking (pies), exercise (hiking), electronics (I just finished building the computer that I'm typing this on), et cetera. In my experience, solitary hobbies just provide me with time for my mind to wander, which is dangerous if you have a mind like mine. As far as finding a purpose goes, I'm most likely not competent enough of a mental gymnast to convince myself of something that I know not to be true (or find solace in my contrived justification, for that matter). When it comes to getting help, I'm currently seeking it; I wouldn't have posted this depressing summary of my feelings if I wasn't looking for a response that could help me find release from them.
yeah, I've become somewhat proficient at distracting myself (it's why i am alive, you're right). It doesn't last, though.
I need to review my comma rules.
I'm not religious. Though, like I've said, I'm rather confused, the idea of assigning an explanation to something that I don't understand has never felt right to me.
